name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: Focused tasks such as renaming, inviting, or confirming.

motionProfile.reason: Dialog owns its panel and backdrop presence, the panel's measured block size, scoped paint and owned title/description display; Base UI keeps mounting, modality and focus.

enter.pop/one-shot.reason: The panel owns one opacity and scale entrance envelope and the backdrop owns one stationary opacity entrance on its own rendered host.

exit.fade/one-shot.reason: A closing panel and backdrop each fade out only on their own opacity channel while Base UI retains the native unmount protocol.

geometry.resize/measured.reason: The panel shell owns one clamped measured block-size transaction over its natural content while it is open and not yet closing.

state.color/css-transition.reason: Content, backdrop, title and description each own their declared scoped paint on their own physical region, with focus and unverified palettes immediate.

text.change/changed-runs.reason: A directly supplied plain Title or Description string replaces only its changed graphemes; arbitrary rich children keep their native identity.

number.roll/reels.reason: A directly supplied supported numeric quantity in Title or Description rolls only its changed places; strings and identifiers remain text.
